objective: Add offline self-contained playable Arena practice using license-cleared BUKLOD V2 and SFX/animation assets without enabling ranked rewards or changing live app.
productionBaselineEvidence: main source 536741f8d97fc9dec91503c89f1c1160e5987ce0 checked; source-only identity, production artifact/runtime unverified. No production mutation.
chosenApproach: Self-contained static HTML, embedded media, independently testable deterministic simulation. No native modules or user data.
selectionRationale: Avoid live-account fake multiplayer and premature wallet changes; retain Genesis season aesthetics and existing Kingdom compatibility.
alternativeApproaches: Godot native embedding rejected until signed compatible APK and target-device QA.
Fake server-backed multiplayer rejected; no trusted gateway/signatures/ledger settlement available.
acceptanceChecks: Offline HTML loads with no networking and runs one local player vs explicitly labeled bots.
Gameplay mode/character/relay/void tests pass with zero economy changes.
No existing app route, backend, or native dependencies altered.
Usage rights for included source packs are documented.
preserveBehaviors: Production BP/QMP and Diamond wallets never modified
AdMob, navigation, Wall, Connect, RLS and auth untouched

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Adds isolated nonrewarding practice and uses Character names only; no character progression or assets changed
preservedBehaviors: Season 1 and 2 progression/item authorities remain untouched

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Standalone HTML requires no native/config changes, cannot modify production runtime.
preservedBehaviors: Existing runtime, launcher, ads and navigation unchanged.
